title: BCT metric definition
description: Frozen contract 03. A metric that fails this schema fails the build. Two rules the schema cannot express are enforced in app/registry.py instead: tenant_id must appear in grain (contract 03 rule 1), and pdp_class may never be 'secret'.

name.description: snake_case, unique, stable. Renaming is a breaking change (contract 03 rule 5).

grain.description: The lowest level the metric may be requested at. tenant_id is always present.

dimensions.description: Legal group-by keys. The compiler allow-lists against exactly this.

column.description: Column the filter applies to, when it differs from the filter key.

source_model.description: The dbt model in schema marts that answers this metric.

measure.description: The column the aggregation is applied to. Not used by 'ratio' metrics, which declare numerator and denominator instead.

derived_dimensions.description: Dimensions computed from a base column rather than selected directly, e.g. date_month from date_day. Deliberately NOT free-form SQL: only a base column and an enumerated date grain, so 'the API never accepts raw SQL' holds without qualification.

channel_note.description: Required when source_model unions channels: states explicitly that summing across the channel column is intended. mart_revenue_daily UNIONs invoice/pos/ppob_commission, and summing across them must be a declared decision rather than an accident of a missing GROUP BY.

numerator.description: Ratio numerator. Required when aggregation is 'ratio'. 'count_true' is COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE col) - SUM(boolean) is invalid in Postgres and SUM(col::int) silently truncates a numeric column.

denominator.description: Ratio denominator. Required when aggregation is 'ratio'. Division is guarded by NULLIF, so an empty denominator yields NULL rather than 0.

growth_over.description: The time dimension a 'period_growth' metric lags across. Must also appear in dimensions, and the caller must request it.
